system_prompt_style.note: Prompt-building code (story_generator.py, critic.py) is listed in the file tree but not included in the evidence bundle.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Three-path retrieval (Idea/Domain/Paper) with two-stage ranking (Jaccard + Embedding).
env_context_strategy.note: Knowledge-graph pattern retrieval: Jaccard lexical ranking plus embeddings. Closest value; could arguably be coded mixed.

context_compaction.note: The pipeline is a fixed series of calls. No history-handling code was in the bundle.

observation_format.note: Tool-free pipeline. The observation conversion code was not in the bundle.

tool_call_format.note: The pipeline appears to parse JSON LLM outputs (critic strict_json), but the parser code is not in the bundle.

tool_count.note: No tool registry in the bundle. The system appears to be a fixed pipeline without model-invoked tools.

edit_primitive.note: The system outputs a JSON story, not file edits. The tool definitions were not in the bundle.

protocol_standardization.note: requirements.txt was not included in the bundle, so a dependency grep was not possible.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Each revised pattern is re-submitted to the same review process, forming an explicit generate–review–revise loop.
loop_primitives.note: Stages run in a fixed order: pattern selection -> story generation -> critic review -> refinement.

planning_granularity.note: The research pattern/story is a structured object that is revised across iterations. A planner.py exists but its code was not in the bundle.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Implements an anchored multi-agent review system for objective feedback.
multi_agent_topology.note: Specialised LLM roles (generator, reflector, critic roles: methodology/novelty/storyteller) are arranged in a fixed sequence.

long_term_memory.note: The knowledge graph is built offline from papers; it is not persisted from past runs.

state_persistence.note: The index_resume setting applies only to index building, not to resuming a run.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Blind Judge + τ-calibrated critic. strict_json=true means: invalid JSON -> retry -> still invalid => fail the run (no silent fallback).
self_verification.note: The judge is the same backbone model in separate role calls. There is also a verification collision check (verification.enable).

retry_policy.evidence_quote: This process repeats until the reviewer judges the pattern to be sufficiently novel, coherent, and technically plausible, or until further iterations no longer yield improvement.
retry_policy.note: Novelty pivot is capped by max_pivots 2.

rollback.evidence_quote: only revisions that improve the reviewer scores are retained; otherwise, the system rolls back to the previous version.
rollback.note: The rollback is of the story version, not the filesystem.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: This process repeats until the reviewer judges the pattern to be sufficiently novel, coherent, and technically plausible, or until further iterations no longer yield improvement.
termination_condition.note: test_pass is the closest value for passing the critic. Iteration caps are likely but their code was not in the bundle.

execution_isolation.note: No code-execution actions are in evidence.

tracing.evidence_quote: Run logging writes a folder per run: log/run_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_<pid>_<rand>/. Set enable=false to disable logging entirely.
tracing.note: The README mentions events.jsonl and per-run structured logs. Logging is on by default.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Idea2Paper is an end-to-end research agent framework

model_agnostic.note: Providers anthropic, gemini, openai_compatible and openai_responses are listed in the file tree.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Our codebase is publicly available at https://github.com/AgentAlphaAGI/Idea2Paper.git.

first_release_date.note: Date of v1.0.0 tag as given in evidence header; whether it is the first tag is not shown.

pinned_version.note: Full hash not given in evidence; short hash only.

stars.note: Star count from evidence header; retrieval date not stated.
